title: Midday Sunwatch
text:
🌤️ Midday Sunwatch — October 31, 2026

🔆️ Solar activity: Low (B2.4)
🔥 Latest solar flare: B3.8 (Peaked October 31, 2026 at 15:42 UTC)
💨 Solar wind speed: 458 km/s (Elevated)
🧲 Bz: −7.4 nT (Southward)
🌎 Geomagnetic activity: Quiet (Kp 2.67)
🚨 NOAA Warning: Geomagnetic K-index of 4 expected

Bz is pointing south. 🌐👀💨

Images: NASA SDO/AIA — 193, 335, 171, 304, 131, 94 Å
Data: NOAA Space Weather Prediction Center
